data.name: Security.Summary.Empty
data.value: Security posture has not been assessed yet.

data.name: Security.Guidance.SEC-AV-ACTIVE
data.value: Restore active antivirus protection through the approved management channel.

data.name: Security.Guidance.SEC-AV-PLATFORM
data.value: Update the active antivirus platform through enterprise management.

data.name: Security.Guidance.SEC-AV-DEFINITIONS
data.value: Update antivirus definitions/signatures through the active provider's supported mechanism.

data.name: Security.Guidance.SEC-AV-RTP
data.value: Restore real-time protection through the approved antivirus policy.

data.name: Security.Guidance.SEC-AV-TAMPER
data.value: Review tamper protection through the enterprise antivirus policy.

data.name: Security.Guidance.SEC-FIREWALL
data.value: Restore an effective firewall through approved local or centralized policy.

data.name: Security.Guidance.SEC-OS-UPDATES
data.value: Install required Windows updates through the workstation's configured enterprise update source.

data.name: Security.Guidance.SEC-BITLOCKER-OS
data.value: Protect the operating-system volume with BitLocker only through corporate policy with recovery-key escrow.

data.name: Security.Guidance.SEC-BITLOCKER-DATA
data.value: Protect applicable internal data volumes with BitLocker through corporate policy.

data.name: Security.Guidance.SEC-SECUREBOOT
data.value: Enable UEFI Secure Boot through the approved firmware-management process.

data.name: Security.Guidance.SEC-BIOS-ADMIN-PASSWORD
data.value: Set the BIOS/UEFI Supervisor/Admin password through the approved OEM or centralized process.

data.name: Security.Guidance.SEC-BOOT-RESTRICTIONS
data.value: Restrict external and network boot through approved BIOS/UEFI management.

data.name: Security.Guidance.SEC-UAC
data.value: Restore UAC through the enterprise Windows policy.

data.name: Security.Guidance.SEC-TPM
data.value: Review TPM 2.x presence and readiness; make changes only through the approved process.

data.name: Security.Guidance.SEC-VBS-HVCI
data.value: Review VBS/HVCI (Memory Integrity) and enable it through an approved compatibility-aware policy.

data.name: Security.Guidance.SEC-LOCAL-ADMINS
data.value: Compare direct local Administrators members with the approved allow-list and remove excess rights through the normal access process.
